Context

Banking QA creates strong constraints for Applied AI.

Unlike toy QA examples, banking workflows involve transaction correctness, regression coverage, multiple channels, auditability, API contracts, database state, and failure classification. This is why the banking work strengthens the Agentic QA positioning.

Core Banking PoC

Cross-platform automation proof.

The Core Banking automation proof of concept covered Web, iOS, and Android automation, supporting a successful automation proposal and showing practical delivery across channels.

Payment Hub

API, database, regression, and stress testing.

The Payment Hub integration work involved Postman API testing, SQL validation, regression testing, and JMeter stress testing. This project is the practical QA-domain anchor behind the Agentic QA story.

Why it matters

This is the domain bridge from QA automation to Agentic QA.

Omni-Agent and APIT are more convincing because they sit on top of real QA experience: how testers validate flows, how regression breaks, how API docs drift, and why generated test cases need traceable evaluation.

Proof

Supported a Core Banking automation PoC and delivered Payment Hub API, database, regression, and stress testing workflows.
